passages.note: A No vote on third reading names no identification requirement she would impose, so it shows a side and not a rung.

passages.provision_quote: Is a citizen of the United States and has provided SATISFACTORY evidence of CITIZENSHIP as PRESCRIBED in section 16-166
passages.note: The chaptered text prints the registration-citizenship provision but names no voter, so it carries no actor or tally quote.
The overview page lists sponsors and the governor's signature; Hernandez appears nowhere on it, so it establishes no act of hers.

rows.reasoning: Hernandez voted No on HB 2492 (2022), which conditions registration on "satisfactory evidence of citizenship", so the record places her against "Require documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote" and nothing more. It does not separate "Require no identification to vote, verifying voters by signature or existing records." from the non-photo-ID and photo-ID rungs, and ruling out one rung is not evidence for any of the others.
